domains.title: Auth / Registration
domains.materialDeviations: No material deviation identified: the split image/form composition, brand hierarchy, RTL controls, CTA prominence and purpose-built mobile flow align with the approved Auth reference.

domains.title: Owner Onboarding
domains.materialDeviations: The actual onboarding entry is branded, but most Desktop steps become sparse full-width forms with large unused areas; the approved reference keeps a compact guided rail, stronger imagery and a denser premium step composition.

domains.title: Owner Dashboard
domains.materialDeviations: Actual Desktop uses an oversized central hero and lower information density; the approved reference uses a compact image banner, six simultaneous metrics, three operational panels and a visible quick-action rail. Mobile hierarchy also differs materially.

domains.title: Children / Classrooms / Child Profile / Enrollment
domains.materialDeviations: The routes and responsive layouts are present, but the current QA rendering replaces much of the reference avatar and classroom imagery with initials or pale placeholders and uses a substantially airier card/table composition than the approved reference.

domains.title: Parent — Assigned
domains.materialDeviations: The assigned Parent experience is functional and branded, but the dashboard/profile presentation lacks the reference's visible child portraits, camera imagery and compact multi-panel hierarchy; actual Desktop is materially sparser.

domains.title: Parent — Unassigned
domains.materialDeviations: No material deviation identified in the intentional unassigned state: it explains the missing relationship, exposes safe enrollment/discovery actions, preserves role boundaries and uses purpose-built Desktop and Mobile compositions.

domains.title: Parent — Multi-Child
domains.materialDeviations: The captured multi-child state presents one selected child through a dropdown and does not provide the reference's visible multi-child card selector and simultaneous child context; the role state is therefore not visually proven to the approved composition.

domains.title: Attendance / Pickup
domains.materialDeviations: No material deviation identified: the actual attendance and pickup workspaces retain the approved metric, filter, status and action hierarchy with separate, touch-oriented Mobile compositions.

domains.title: Staff Full Platform
domains.materialDeviations: No material deviation identified across the captured Staff dashboard, profile, shifts, clock actions, documents, tasks, messages and settings; shell, density, imagery and mobile navigation remain reference-aligned.

domains.title: Candidate / Recruitment
domains.materialDeviations: No material deviation identified: the candidate hero, progress states, job discovery, documents, applications and manager recruitment surfaces use the approved branded card system on Desktop and Mobile.

domains.title: Inspector
domains.materialDeviations: No material deviation identified: the inspector shell, image-led assignment hero, metrics, findings, corrective actions and mobile flows preserve the approved Inspector hierarchy.

domains.title: Finance
domains.materialDeviations: No material deviation identified: finance keeps clear tuition/subscription separation, strong metrics, status chips, bounded tables and purpose-built Mobile cards in the approved visual language.

domains.title: Messaging / Notifications
domains.materialDeviations: No material deviation identified across thread lists, conversations, broadcasts, readiness states and notification preferences; the captured empty selection is an intentional state rather than a broken surface.

domains.title: Documents
domains.materialDeviations: No material deviation identified: the document center, detail, preview, upload and lifecycle states preserve the reference's hierarchy, status language, privacy treatment and Mobile cards.

domains.title: Tasks / Complaints / Corrective Actions
domains.materialDeviations: No material deviation identified: the three domains remain distinct while sharing the approved list/detail, status, deadline and action patterns across Desktop and Mobile.

domains.title: Inspections
domains.materialDeviations: No material deviation identified across dashboard, checklist, evidence, findings, report and remediation captures; the implementation extends the approved Inspector design system consistently.

domains.title: Reports / Analytics
domains.materialDeviations: No material deviation identified: report selection, configuration, chart/table results, bounded export and Mobile views use the approved hierarchy and truthful data states.

domains.title: Safety / Cameras
domains.materialDeviations: The actual product correctly shows unavailable, denied and provider-readiness truth, but it cannot visually reproduce the reference's imagery-rich live camera grid/detail composition without verified Live capability. This is a material visual deviation required by capability truth.

domains.title: Platform Admin
domains.materialDeviations: The canonical Admin areas and metrics are present, but the actual dashboard is materially airier than the reference and its Desktop navigation has a pale gradient region with weak contrast; the approved dense charts, activity column and consistently dark navy shell are not faithfully matched.

domains.title: Settings / Account / Permissions
domains.materialDeviations: Actual Settings uses a large hero, single side category rail and vertically stacked sections; the approved reference uses a compact four-column Desktop composition with profile, security, preferences, Garden and billing visible together. The hierarchy and density differ materially.

domains.title: Global States / RTL / Accessibility
domains.materialDeviations: No material deviation identified in the captured global treatments: status meaning is textual, focus is visible, state colors are consistent, touch layouts are purpose-built and mixed-direction values remain readable.
